name: Ajalon
overview: Ajalon appears in Scripture as both a city and a valley with significant historical and tribal associations. It was a city within the territory of Dan, assigned to the Levites and designated as a city of refuge, yet the Amorites dwelling there were not fully driven out (Judges 1:35; Joshua 21:24). Ajalon is also noted as a city in the territory of Zebulun, where Elon the Zebulonite was buried (Judges 12:12), and a city within Judah’s borders, known for its fortified status alongside other key cities (2 Chronicles 11:10). Additionally, the valley of Ajalon is the setting for Joshua’s prayer for the sun and moon to stand still during Israel’s victory over the Amorites (Joshua 10:12), highlighting its role in God’s deliverance of His people.
